description: Inspired by classic espresso machines, complete with loads of features that your junior barista will love, the Classic World Coffee Machine comes with a coffee pod, sugar, cups, spoons and milk, giving your child everything they need for hours of imaginative play. It also helps kids develop important social and fine motor skills, making it a wonderful addition to any playroom or kitchen set.

name: Classic World Rainmaker
description: Wave it, shake it, rotate it and roll it. This Rainmaker is a perfect size for a toddler's hand and lets them explore how the beads cascade down, making beautiful raindrop sounds. It's a lovely and unusual which they'll rediscover over and over again.

name: Djeco Create with Stickers Sea Creatures
description: Inspire creative stickering with the Create With Stickers Sea Creatures. The set, which is a great addition to crafty sessions at home includes over 450 stickers with 16 pictures to decorate. Ideal for allowing them to be creative as well as building fine motor skills, they'll love seeing what silly sea creatures they can come up with.

name: CoConuts Matte Helmet
description: The CoConuts Matte Helmet has been designed for safety and comfort. It features an outer shell of hard plastic and a foam inner, which cushions the shock if your kid has a fall. A small wheel lets you adjust the helmet for a perfect fit, while the adjustable chinstrap keeps it in place. Ventilation openings also keep their heads cool while they ride. • Available in colours to match your Trybike • Easily adjustable • Foam lining • Ventilation holes to keep your little one cool • Adjustable chin strap with magnetic buckle, for quick release • Extra Small: 41-51cm (head circumference) • Small/Medium: 51-56cm (head circumference) The styles differ slightly based on the size of the helmet. The Small and Medium helmets come with a peak on the front, whereas the Extra Small has no peak and has ex

name: Classic World Firefighting Set
description: Calling all heroes! The Firefighting Set from Classic World is great for any kid who loves to rush to the rescue. With a fire extinguisher with a realistic squeezing action, a loudhailer, vest, torch, axe, walkie-talkie and road cone. Lots of make-believe fun awaits and they'll also learn an important thing or two about fire-prevention.

name: Djeco Tinou Shop Music Box
description: The Tinou Shop Music Box is full of cute details and fun bits for a kid to explore. We love the little drawers on the inside and at the bottom and all your child has to do to make the ballerina dance and hear Mozart's 'The Magic Flute' is turn the handle on the back. A real treasure of a treasure chest that will be loved for years.

name: Djeco Do It Yourself Like A Princess
description: It's great to have something up your sleeve for those moments when the kids just need a little extra entertaining. The Do It Yourself Like A Princess kit from Djeco makes a nice change from the usual, with 4 bling-tastic tiaras waiting to be decorated using the self-adhesive mosaic pieces provided. It's a great activity for parties, playdates or school holidays. They'll fit adult heads too. (You know you'll be tempted!)

name: Classic World Table Top Easel
description: Inspire kids to get creative with the versatile Table Top Easel by Classic World. An ideal space-saving design for budding artists, they'll love swapping between the chalkboard and whiteboard, plus using the magnetic letters too. It's an ideal play and learn toy for preschoolers, giving them the opportunity to develop their creativity and spelling skills at the same time. The compact, folding design means you can move the easel from room to room, or even pack it up for trips away, for their own kind of art retreat.

name: Classic World Vintage Music Set
description: Travel back in time with Classic World's Vintage Music Set for babies and toddlers. We love the beautiful vintage colour scheme and classic instruments - a xylophone, rattle, recorder and tambourine. As a collection, they're sure to inspire your little one's imagination and creativity, whilst developing their musical sense and powers of self expression. • Tambourine, xylophone, recorder, rattle • Encourages musicality & self expression • Best from 18 months+

name: Djeco Baby Doll Suitcase Cerise
description: In this adorable Baby Doll Suitcase, your child gets Baby Cerise, plus everything she needs to go on holiday, worry-free: PJs, a hat, a change of clothes (front-closing wrap-over top, bloomers and a pair of booties), a nappy, a feeding bottle and a bib. Baby Cerise is lightweight and the perfect size (32cm) for little arms, with a soft body and head, arms and legs made of soft-touch vinyl, making her a joy to cuddle and play with.

name: Classic World Wooden Car Transporter
description: The Wooden Car Transporter is a fresh update of Classic World's popular transporter toy. Perfect for any mini vehicle fanatic, little ones can get hands on, using the moveable ramp to load cars on to the lorry, which then turns it into a double-decker once they are all aboard. It's a long-lasting that will inspire creative play for years, while at the same time helping to develop fine motor skills and dexterity.

name: Classic World Locking Door
description: This Locking Door shape sorting toy by Classic World has loads to intrigue the curious toddler. They'll spend ages experimenting with putting the key through different shapes to try opening the locking door. It's a great little toy to teach them about different shapes and patterns and help them practise their fine motor skills.

name: Classic World Fire Engine Busy Board
description: This Fire Engine Busy Board offers hours of fun for busy little hands with its maze, doors, gears, a bell, and wheels. The colourful and friendly design encourages them to plug away at each challenge, improving their concentration and hand-eye coordination. It makes a great toy for travel too as it's nice and compact.

name: Djeco Introduction to Dough
description: Let your child get creative in 3D with Introduction To Dough Classic set and they'll have all they need to be bold and experimental. There are 4 tubs of soft and pliable modelling dough, plus 21 fun tools for your mini modeler to go wild with - from molds and cutters to fun stencils. There are countless hours of sensory fun to be had here, plus the dough won't stain hands, clothes or surfaces, no matter how long they play for.

name: Mr Maria Smiley Bundle of Light Lamp
description: This playful pal will help hugely with the bedtime routine. With a l ow energy LED lamp that means it's always cool to the touch, t he Bundle Of Light from Mr Maria gives a soft, comforting glow, creating a cozy bedtime atmosphere. Made of soft-touch BPA-free silicone, easy to use and totally child-safe: the perfect companion for a peaceful night’s sleep. • Child-safe cool-to-touch lamp • Battery Powered • Great for camping & travel too"

name: My Carry Potty
description: My Carry Potty is loved by over a million parents globally. Experience the UK's best selling potty. Reach the potty trained milestone with ease. The revolutionary, multi award winning design ensures a hassle free potty training journey. Anytime, anywhere! • Unique Carry Handle to encourage consistency. Potty training anywhere! • Revolutionary leakproof seal – never any mess! Simple, stress-free potty training! • Adorable designs and cool colours to make potty training fun! • Secure lock mechanism, just close click and carry! • Nonslip feet for extra security. • Large Bowl and comfortable seat • No disposable bags required. • Designed by the UK’s potty training expert, Amanda Jenner

name: Liewood Neil Sippy Cup - Sea Creature
description: The Neil 'no-spill' training cup in BPA-free silicone has a removable lid with a small sprout and smooth easy-to-grip handles, for confident handling and drinking by babies and toddlers alike. It tones nicely with Liewood tableware and makes a sophisticated addition to any tabletop or high chair. • No spill training cup • Easy-grip handles • Capacity 150ml • Best from 6 months+

name: Djeco Maxi Plane Kite
description: Let's go fly a kite, up to the highest heights!' If you're a fan of the original Mary Poppins you can channel your inner Dick Van Dyke while you teach your kid to sing along as they experience the sheer exhilaration of piloting this magificent Maxi Plane Kite with its massive 125cm wingspan and mighty 250cm long ribbon tail. It's light, simple to handle and takes off easily, with just 2 pieces to assemble, a line to tie to attach the handle and it's ready! It comes with a storage pouch too.

name: Trybike basket
description: Give your Trybike a timeless twist with this charming wicker-style basket. Whether it’s for carrying snacks, soft toys or secret treasures, it adds a fun and functional flair to your little one’s ride. • Classic plastic wicker design for a retro feel • Leather-look straps for easy handlebar attachment • Measures 24cm x 21cm x 15cm • Fits the Trybike Steel Bike only • Not suitable for Trybike 4-in-1 Wood

name: Djeco Creativity kit
description: The Creativity Kit is a two-storey treasure trove packed with everything kids need to let their imaginations fly. Beads, pompoms, googly eyes, stickers, gemstones, chenille stems and more - all in one big box of fun. With plenty of ideas included, it’s perfect for crafty afternoons and big creative energy. • Two-storey box packed with supplies • Includes beads, pompoms, googly eyes, gemstones & more • Inspires open-ended creativity • Ideas included inside • Suitable for ages 5-8 years

name: Djeco Tap Tap Garden
description: A classic nursery school activity that's great for developing their pincer grip and dexterity, we love the Djeco Tap Taps for their quirky graphics and lovely neat boxes that everything fits into. Choose from a beautiful abundant flower garden or a snazzy space scene with loads of out-of-this-world detailing. With both sets, there are inspo cards for kids to reproduce or they can just get generally creative!

name: Little Dutch Playpen Mat Little Farm
description: Pop your baby on this soft, padded Play Mat Little Farm from Little Dutch and they'll discover lots of different materials and activities to explore, like a mirror, a rattle, crinkly things, even hidden toys. Soft and stimulating, in lovely muted colours, it's perfect to pop on the floor at tummy time, to use in the playpen or to take with you when traveling.

name: My Carry Potty My Little Training Pants
description: Give your toddler the confidence to transition away from nappies with My Little Training Pants! Presented in a 3pk, to ensure you are fully prepared to start your potty training journey. • Soft absorbent Layers– Capture small accidents • Soft, comfy and breathable– Super soft and organic comfy cotton fabrics are perfect for active toddlers. • Supports potty training Allows children to feel some of the wetness to learn what they must do. • Save money and the planet Switching to reusable pants from expensive nappies supports a more sustainable environment while saving money! • Designed by the UK’s potty-training expert • Matches to the ‘My Carry Potty’ range for consistency – The key to potty training success! Due to hygiene reasons, we do not permit returns or exchanges for My Little Traini

name: BANZ Kids Ear Defenders
description: Whether it's a sporting event or a particularly noisy walk to school, these Kidz Ear Defenders will become your go-to to keep sensory overload and tears at bay. They have foam-filled cushions, which means they cover sensitive ears comfortably and properly. At just 190 grams, they're also lightweight. NOTE: If they're too tight, they can be stretched slightly: place two chairs back to back and stretch the defenders over them for a while, after which they'll have stretched by a small amount. • Significantly reduces loud noises • Comfy & padded • Great for loud events • Best for 3 - 10 years

name: Djeco Animambo Set of 3 Instruments
description: The Djeco Animambo Set Of 3 Instruments delivers whole lot of musical fun in one package. Containing a wooden tambourine painted in bright, vibrant colours with a lovely toucan design, plus a coordinating wooden maraca and a castanet, together they're a brilliant starter set for any kid who likes music, or who you'd like to encourage in that direction!

name: Djeco Maxi Bird Kite
description: Let's go fly a kite, up to the highest heights!' Stack them into a tower or nest them together, each one has an animal that fits inside, making for lots of open play and learning potential, while also helping to build their storytelling, role playing and fine-motor skills.

name: Djeco Baby Doll Mealtime Set
description: Dejco's Baby Doll Mealtime Set contains everything they need to keep their baby doll gurgling with joy: a bottle, a biscuit, a spoon, a plate, a bib and a muslin square for when bubba needs a little burp. The fabric bag has a long adjustable strap and a handy side pocket for the bottle and lots of room to pack everything away between feeds.

name: Djeco Delighted Palace
description: Delighted Palace is a pretty mansion-shaped music box, perfect for storing jewellery and secret treasures. Turn the handle, open the lid, and surprise! A delicately carved princess twirls to The Magic Flute by Mozart, reflected in a shaped mirror. A charming keepsake for little daydreamers and collectors alike. • Plays The Magic Flute by Mozart • Spinning princess figure • Shaped mirror inside • Great for jewellery and keepsakes • Suitable for ages 4+ years

name: Mr Maria Miffy Bundle of Light Lamp
description: This playful pal will help hugely with the bedtime routine. It's one of those gorgeous classic toys that also looks lovely on the shelf, and fits with any room's colour scheme.

name: Little Dutch Lunch Box - Pink
description: This fun-looking Little Dutch Lunch Box with its removable bento insert and clever little integrated fork gives you scope to really mix it up with your kid's lunches, so they never get bored. It's easy for them to open and close, made in a robust and shockproof BPA-free polypropylene and it can be popped in the dishwasher when lunchtime is done. • Bento box with removable insert & integrated fork • Adds variety to their lunchtimes • Easy to open & close

name: Little Dutch Vintage Campervan
description: The Little Dutch Vintage Vehicle With Peg Dolls is just carefree vibes all round. We love the VW camper-inspired stylings and the peg doll family look set to have loads of fun as they voyage round the playroom or garden. They even have luggage and a surfboard to bring along too. Where will their first stop be: Newquay? Malibu? Hawaii? Any kid will have loads of fun deciding where. • Camper van, 4 peg dolls, luggage & surfboard • Inspires imaginative play • Best from 18 months+

name: Clown Fish T-Shirt
description: Bright, bold and oh-so-soft — this Clown Fish T-Shirt brings ocean vibes and all-day comfort to your mini explorer’s outfit. Perfect to pair with shorts or leggings . • Made from 70% viscose bamboo and 30% organic cotton • Popper at shoulder up to 2 years

name: Djeco Baby Doll Rocker
description: There's really nothing cuter than watching your little one nurture 'their' little one and caring through role-play is a great way for them to develop empathy and social skills. The Baby Doll Rocker from Djeco is a beautiful wooden cradle with a blue quilted cover and pillow, made from 100% cotton double gauze. It makes a great addition to their bedtime routine, helping them to learn about the value of rest and sleep as they gently rock their baby doll to the land of nod.

name: Little Dutch Tractor with Trailer Little Farm
description: Children who love trips to the farm will love the Tractor with Trailer from Little Ducth. This wooden vehicle includes a detachable trailer, so they can push along the truck by itself. Including a peg doll farmer, 5 farm animals, including a horse, cow, sheep and pig, they will have a great time thinking up some down-on-the-farm themed pretend play, loading them on and off the trailer and driving them around. Made from wood, it's a toy that will last a long time.

name: Liewood Ryle Printed Tableware Set
description: The Ryle Printed Tableware Set is a great combo of essential dining items that sets them up for learning their way round meal and snack times. Made from easy-grip, unbreakable, BPA-free silicone, the set includes a bowl, plate and sippy cup, plus a genius first spoon and fork that have grippy tactile hooped handles and 'business ends' that are the right size for little mouths and gentle on tender gums. • Bowl, plate, sippy cup & first cutlery set • Encourages independent eating • Easy-grip & non-slip silicone • Best from 6 months+

name: Liewood Sylvester Washcloth 3-Pack
description: Make bathtime more fun with the Sylvester Washcloths – a set of three animal-shaped washcloths that double as playful hand puppets. Made from thick, super-soft GOTS-certified organic cotton, they’re gentle on delicate skin and easy for both little ones and grown-ups to use. Slip them over your hand for better grip and more giggles at bath or shower time. • Made from 100% GOTS-certified organic cotton • Thick, soft terry fabric - gentle yet absorbent • Fun safari animal shapes for playful washing • Size: 21cm x 15cm • Machine washable at 40°C

name: Djeco 6 Finger Paint Tubes Classic

name: Djeco 6 Crafts Activity Pack Animal Houses

There's something for all tastes and several kids can create together, so it's perfect for birthday parties and for playdates. Each craft helps to develop their fine motor skills and creativity whilst learning about colours, shapes, sizes, volume. The set includes pom-poms, googly eyes, glue, illustrated cards to colour, stickers, two-sided wax crayons, safety scissors, transfers and metallic foam mosaic stickers.

name: Djeco Baby Doll Mimosa
description: With big eyes and an angelic face, Djeco's 32 cm tall Doll is perfectly suited to small arms. The flexible cloth body and vinyl limbs can be positioned like a real baby and the sleepy eyes close when it lies down - (almost!) like a real baby. In a cute dress and scarf that are easy to put on and off, this will be love at first sight.

name: Djeco Baby Doll Stroller Flowers
description: Encourage pretend play and teach toddlers about the world around them with the Djeco Stroller. With a light, foldable metal frame and nimble wheels, it's simple for small kids to navigate. Just add a doll or teddy and off they go on their adventures!

name: Djeco Baby Doll Stroller Sunshine

There's a fish that makes fish, otter and tail shapes, a chick that makes chick shapes and bird foot prints and a cat that makes mouse and ball of wool shapes and paw prints. Note: play dough is not included in this set.

name: Djeco Collage For Little Ones
description: Inspire creativity with the Collages For Little Ones set. Ideal for preschoolers, the kit includes different cardboard characters, which are ready to embellish, with stick on clothes, facial features and other details. Kids will adore making their own unique animal images, it's perfect for allowing their artistic flare to flourish.

Pop it on their chest of drawers or place it next to their bed, it'll quickly become their favourite bedroom companion. • Dimensions: 15 x 15 x 30cm

name: Little Dutch Noah's Ark
description: All aboard for adventure! Whether your kid knows the bible story of Noah and the great flood or not, Little Dutch's Noah's Ark is full of drama. A toy they will play with loads and for years. • Ark, 11 animal pairs & Mr & Mrs Noah • Encourages imaginative play • Best from 3 years+

Please note, as we transition to the new Royal Warrant of His Majesty The King, some Pill Cases may still feature the Prince of Wales's Warrant.

name: Capra Golf Card Holder
description: Slim sophistication for the course, our Golf Card Holder is crafted from our Capra leather and features our unique Ettinger Golf Logo. Handmade in England, the grained goat leather is naturally water-resistant and remarkably durable, perfect for regular use. Whether used to carry golf club membership cards or as a stylish everyday card holder, it’s a thoughtful gift for the golf lover who appreciates finer details.

name: Bridle Hide Travel Pass Holder
description: Travel in style with this eye catching Travel Pass Holder in our signature London Tan. You can keep all your travel cards, Oyster cards and train tickets safely in one place with this smart case. Use the thumb slits on the sides to slide your cards out effortlessly, a feature much appreciated during busy rush hours on public transport. There is a slip pocket down the full side of the holder where you can store receipts or other useful cards.

name: Long Wallet with Zipped Pocket
description: Our Long Wallet with Zipped Pocket is an elegant purse which can also be used as an alternative to a coat wallet. This unisex wallet can fit seamlessly into small bags. This wallet can fit your cards, notes and coins all in one convenient place. Available in two colour combinations of Charcoal/Antelope/Lime, or Black/Dove/Baby Blue.

name: Capra AirTag Accessories Set
description: This set is the perfect gift for the tech-savvy traveler. Expertly crafted in goat leather, the passport case has two side slip pockets to keep passport, tickets and receipts in one place. Paired with the sleek AirTag Keyring, you can effortlessly track your keys. Please note, only the Passport Case can be personalised.

name: Gift Wrapping
description: Our gift wrapping includes our iconic box, finished with a luxurious tied silk ribbon in Ettinger grey, and an Ettinger gift bag.

name: Capra Everyday Set
description: The Capra Billfold Wallet with 6 C/C and AirTag Keyring make a refined Everyday Set for those who appreciate classic craftsmanship. The wallet keeps your essentials neatly organised, while the keyring adds a touch of luxury to your keys. Please note, only the Billfold Wallet can be personalised.

name: Capra Golf Scorecard Holder
description: Crafted in England from our signature goat leather, this Golf Scorecard Holder offers a refined solution for keeping your score with quiet confidence. The grained texture of the leather - naturally water-resistant and remarkably durable - makes it particularly well-suited to the open fairways and ever-changing British weather. The size and shape of the holder allows for a wide range of scorecards to be stored and will fit easily into your back pocket. Each includes a classic standard 18 hole scorecard for friendly competitions.

name: Campbell's of Beauly x Ettinger 6oz Hip Flask
description: Equally suited to the field or fireside, our distinctive Capra 6oz Hip Flask has been given a countryside twist with a unique Chocolate colourway and Forest Green with a contrast stitch, designed in collaboration with the iconic Scottish tailors, Campbell’s of Beauly. Handcrafted in durable goat leather, the flask has a slight curve, allowing it to fit perfectly into your pockets, ideal for a long country walk or fishing. Read more about the collaboration here .

name: Capra AirTag Passport Case
description: Expertly crafted from our bestselling Capra goat leather, the AirTag Passport Case is a stylish yet practical travel accessory. Featuring a fixed leather bound sleeve outside of the case while the interior includes two slip pockets, securely fastened with a monogrammed popper closure. *Does not include AirTag*

name: Bridle Hide Minimalist Set
description: For the minimalist in your life, we've created this Bridle Hide Flat Credit Card Case and the Rectangular Key Fob set. The card case is perfect for when you need to take just the bare minimum, while the key fob keeps your keys organised in one place. Please note, only the Flat Credit Card Case can be personalised.

name: Sterling Travel Set
description: This Sterling gift set is a must for travellers who love a pop of colour. Featuring the Passport Case and the Luggage Tag, this duo will keep all your travel essentials safe and help you never lose sight of your luggage. Handmade in Soft Italian Calf leather, the set comes in four vibrant colours inspired by the British notes.

name: Capra Dollar Wallet with 6 C/C
description: The ‘Dollar Wallet’, crafted in our durable Capra leather, has been designed to be longer and narrower than Ettinger’s typical billfold design, making it the perfect size for US dollars. This compact design, slides comfortably into your pocket and is available in 5 signature Capra colours; Black, Marine Blue, Forest Green, Bordeaux and Tan. Please note: this wallet is designed specifically for U.S. dollar bills and may not accommodate other currencies. For other banknote sizes, please try our Capra Billfold Wallet with 6 C/C.

name: Leather Balm
description: Our Ettinger Leather Balm will ensure your leather pieces remain in great condition for years to come. To start with, wipe the leather of the product you wish to clean with a damp cloth, then leave to dry naturally. Apply sparingly a small amount of the balm on the leather to clean and nourish it.

name: Capra Minimalist Set
description: The Capra Flat Credit Card Case and Round Key Fob is a great gift set for minimalists. The card case is ideal for those carrying only a couple of cards, while the key fob helps you keep all your keys in one place, combining practicality and elegance. Please note, only the Flat Credit Card Case can be personalised.

name: Sterling Minimalist Set
description: This Sterling set is perfect for those who love a pop of colour, but prefer to keep their accessories minimal. The Flat Credit Card Case holds a few cards and notes while the matching Stirrup Keyring is sleek and spacious enough for multiple sets of keys.

name: Capra Games Set
description: This Capra set featuring the Single Playing Card Case and the Poker Dice Set is perfect for the game enthusiast. The Playing Card Case offers an elegant home for your favourite deck while the Poker Dice Set is ideal for playing on the go due to its compact size. Please note, only the Single Playing Card Case can be personalised.

name: Hunters & Frankau X Ettinger Leather Cigar Wrap
description: Hunters & Frankau and Ettinger have created a distinctive and innovative cigar wrap bringing form and modernity, as well as functionality to the question of how best to carry and maintain Havana cigars. Handmade from fine Maldives leather, the wrap offers an elegant buttery soft touch. To learn more about this exquisite collaboration, click here .

name: Capra Small Pet Pill Case
description: An innovative yet stylish solution to keeping track of your pet's medication and/or supplements. Crafted from sumptuous Capra goat leather, each compact piece features a small 7-day pill organiser to ensure your supplements or medication are always in order and on hand. For each Pet Pill Case, 8% of sales will be donated to Wild at Heart Foundation , a charity whose mission it is to end the suffering and improve the wellbeing of vulnerable stray dogs across the world. Learn more.

name: Clubhouse Set
description: Our Clubhouse Set is the ideal gift for golfers. The Card Holder is a practical accessory to store membership cards or use as an everyday card case, whether you're headed to the clubhouse or the city. Made to be attached to your golf bag or belt loop, the Accessory Caddy will keep your game essentials close at hand throughout your round.

name: Bridle Hide Coin Purse with Card Pocket (concealed button)
description: This classic small coin purse keeps all your coins safely in one place and is perfect for everyday use. Made using our sleek Bridle Hide leather, it is durable yet elegant and offers 2 credit card slots, one inside and one on the outside.

name: Capra Essential Set
description: The Capra Flat Card Case and Tray Purse Set is perfect for the minimalist. The card holder can carry 4 visible cards, and several more in the middle section. The tray purse is perfect for separating your change and keeping it safely in one place. The soft grainy leather is strong and durable. The Capra leather used has natural lanolin to protect the leather.

name: Capra Small Travel Pill Case
description: Designed for those wanting to keep track of medication and/or supplements while on the move, this downsized interpretation of Ettinger's renowned weekly pill case, is the epitome of functionality and elegance combined. Crafted from sumptuous Capra goat leather, the pill case features a 7-day pill organiser to ensure your supplements or medication are always in order and on hand. Please note, as we transition to the new Royal Warrant of His Majesty The King, some Pill Cases may still feature the Prince of Wales's Warrant.

name: Heritage Burlington Briefcase
description: Our Burlington Briefcase is a quintessential piece defined by its craftsmanship and detail. Handmade using the finest Buttero leather on the outside and a complimentary neutral-toned suede on the inside, the briefcase is light to carry and the perfect size for a small laptop or iPad. Featuring two A4 sized slip pockets, it is ideal to keep all your documents neatly organised ahead of your meetings.

name: Personalisation Embossing
description: Adding initials onto your wallets or leather accessories ensures the item becomes entirely unique to you. These initials are expertly applied onto each piece by hand, using antique letter sets, ensuring the spacing and positioning is the perfect fit.

name: Capra AirTag Keyring
description: Keep track of your keys in style with our Capra AirTag Keyring. Expertly crafted from our bestselling Capra goat leather, the AirTag Key Ring is available in seven colours including our newest additions, Greige and Pink. The Key Ring sits on a large silver split ring and features an elegant monogrammed popper for secure closure and jacquard fabric lining. *Does not include AirTag*

name: Kensington Tote Bag Pouch
description: Handmade from soft-drummed hide leather. A small loop allows for easy attachment, while its elegant design makes it ideal for storing travel essentials like documents, passports, and cash.

name: Capra Large Pet Pill Case
description: An innovative yet stylish solution to keeping track of your pet's medication and/or supplements. Crafted from sumptuous Capra goat leather, each piece features a 7-day pill organiser to ensure your pet's supplements or medication are always in order and on hand. Each is able to be personalised with your pet's name for a truly unique gift. For each Pet Pill Case, 8% of sales will be donated to Wild at Heart Foundation , a charity whose mission is to end the suffering and improve the wellbeing of vulnerable stray dogs across the world. Learn more.

name: Capra Travel Set
description: Our Capra Passport Case and Luggage Tag are the perfect gift for intrepid travellers. The passport case will keep your travel documents, cards and cash safe and organised, and the luggage tag will ensure your bags and suitcases will always find their way back to you. Both are crafted from durable goat leather to withstand the rigours of travel and resist scratches along the way.

name: Capra Travel Pill Case Set
description: This set is ideal for frequent travellers who like to keep their medication organised. Including both a Large and a Small Travel Pill Case, this set ensures you stay on top of your medication or supplements in style while on the move. Handmade from durable goat leather, each pill case features a 7-day pill organiser to ensure your supplements or medication are always in order and on hand. Please note, as we transition to the new Royal Warrant of His Majesty The King, some Pill Cases may still feature the Prince of Wales's Warrant.

name: 90th Anniversary Key Ring
description: Made in a limited run to mark our 90th Anniversary, this key ring is an iconic style for Ettinger, dating back to the late 1970s. The key ring features a white embossed Ettinger Guardsman logo, our original from 1934, and is made using our Capra goat leather in marine blue. This durable hide feels luxurious and boasts a soft, supple grain that resists scratching, ensuring lasting quality.

name: Capra Dominoes Set
description: Elevate your game nights with our luxury Dominoes Case. Meticulously crafted from our Capra leather, this set is ideal for travel or storage at home. Featuring an Ettinger monogrammed button closure and compact design, the exterior is handmade using a durable goat leather, while the soft suede lining ensures your dominoes stay scratch-free and protected. Each case includes a set of dominoes.

name: Capra Single Playing Cards Case
description: Elevate your card-playing experience with our exquisite Single Playing Card Case, crafted from our bestselling Capra leather. This luxurious case not only offers an elegant home for your favourite deck but also ensures durability and style. Perfect for game nights or travel, this case combines functionality with timeless elegance. Each case includes a single deck of cards.

name: Golf Essentials Set
description: The ultimate bundle for golf lovers, featuring three favourites from the collection. The Scorecard Holder protects your scorecard in style while the Tidy keeps all your golf essentials close at hand when on the course. Pair these with our suede Pouch to store valuables such as your phone, watch or card holder while playing. Please note, only the Scorecard Holder and the Tidy can be personalised.

name: Personalisation Embroidery
description: Personalisation makes every item truly special. You can choose our embroidery personalisation service with your new Cotswold Weekend Bag , Hurlingham Overnight Bag , Piccadilly Tote Bag or Wimbledon Briefcase .

name: Capra Double Playing Cards Case
description: Take your games on the go with our Double Playing Card Case, expertly crafted from our elegant Capra leather. This luxurious case is designed to hold two decks of cards, offering both style and functionality for the discerning card enthusiast. Perfect for game nights or travel, this case combines functionality with timeless elegance. Each case includes two decks of cards.

name: Capra Large Travel Pill Case
description: Designed for those wanting to keep track of medication and/or supplements while on the move, this travel-sized version of our renowned weekly pill case, is the epitome of functionality and elegance combined. Crafted from sumptuous Capra goat leather, each piece features a 7-day pill organiser to ensure your supplements or medication are always in order and on hand.

name: Capra Pet Pill Case Set
description: Ensure your pets' medication is on track with the Capra Pet Pill Case Set, including a Large and a Small Pet Pill Case. For each purchase, 8% of sales will be donated to Wild at Heart Foundation , whose mission it is to end the suffering and improve the wellbeing of stray dogs across the world.

name: Capra Bookmark
description: Our classic leather bookmarks are an essential for stylish readers. Handmade using surplus goat leather from our Capra collection, they play an important role in our sustainability efforts by helping to reduce leather waste. These luxury accessories are decorated with an emboss symbol of an open book, a thoughtful nod to their purpose.

name: Capra Pill Case Home & Travel Set
description: This set brings together two of Ettinger's bestselling products, the original Capra Pill Case and the Travel Pill Case in Large. Designed for those who prioritise their health both at home and on the move, the set will ensure you stay on top of your medication or supplements in style wherever you are. Please note, as we transition to the new Royal Warrant of His Majesty The King, some Pill Cases may still feature the Prince of Wales's Warrant.

name: Capra Poker Dice Set
description: Make every game a stylish occasion with our Poker Dice Set, expertly crafted from our elegant Capra leather. Perfect for playing on the go, the case’s compact size and secure snap closure make it easy to carry for game nights or travel. The exterior is made from durable goat leather while its interior features a soft suede that will keep your dice protected. Includes one set of poker dice.

name: On The Green Set
description: Elevate every game with our Golf Essentials Set. Made to be attached to your golf bag or belt loop, the Accessory Caddy will keep your game essentials close at hand throughout your round. Paired with our elegant Scorecard Holder, you can keep track of your par in style. Please note, only the Scorecard Holder can be personalised.

name: Sterling Pencil Case
description: Bring elegance to your desk with our Sterling Pencil Case. Handmade in black Soft Italian Calf leather, it reveals a vibrant interior in one of four colours inspired by the British notes. Slim enough to fit into the smallest portfolios and bags, this pencil case keeps all your stationery essentials neatly organised in one place.

name: Saint Crispin Billfold Wallet with 6 C/C
description: The classic Billfold Wallet in our unique Saint Crispin leather, our finest calf leather that is vegetable tanned to preserve its natural beauty. It is finished in a very subtle way to give it an exceptionally silky touch and allow it to burnish naturally. Handmade in the UK, the wallet features 6 credit card slots, 2 note pockets and 2 slip pockets to keep all your essentials safe.

name: Sterling Heart Key Fob
description: Keep your keys organised with this colourful heart-shaped key fob. Handmade with Soft Italian Calf leather, this key fob is available in four bright colours making it easy to find your keys in any bag. This key fob will make the perfect gift to a loved one for Valentine's Day or any special anniversary.

name: Capra Ecru Large Jewellery Roll
description: Travel in style with our Capra Ecru Large Jewellery Roll. Featuring three zipped pockets, a ring holder and an earring holder, this luxury roll can store several pairs of earrings, rings, necklaces and more. Handmade with elegant and durable goat leather on the outside and soft suede on the inside, the roll can be fastened using a suede ribbon, keeping all your favourite pieces safe.

name: Capra Ecru Mini Jewellery Roll
description: Our Capra Ecru Mini Jewellery Roll is the ideal travel companion for a few nights away. Handmade with durable goat leather and soft suede on the inside, the roll can fit three pairs of earrings, and a few rings on the ring holder. Keep your small necklaces and bracelets within the two zipped pockets, safely tucked away and tie the roll with a suede ribbon to fasten everything neatly in place.

name: Capra Ecru Large Jewellery / Cufflink Box
description: This Capra Ecru Large box is the perfect travel companion for anyone carrying several pieces of jewellery or sets of cufflinks. Elegant and practical, this luxury accessory is handmade from durable goat leather on the outside and contrasting soft suede on the inside. The sturdy divider can divide the box into nine equal sections, and can be removed easily for additional space.

name: Saint Crispin Coin Purse with Card Pocket
description: Perfect for the ultimate minimalist looking to carry just a few daily essentials with them, this petite accessory keeps your change in one place and has 2 card slots. Saint Crispin is our finest calf leather that is vegetable tanned to preserve the natural beauty. It is finished in a very subtle way to give it an exceptionally silky touch and allow it to burnish naturally.

name: Cotton Polishing Cloth
description: Our 100% cotton polishing cloth gently cleans and polishes your leather accessories. Finished in white with a black Ettinger logo, it pairs perfectly with our Leather Balm to keep your leather nourished and looking its best.

name: Sterling Glasses Case
description: Our Sterling Glasses Case is a vibrant and lightweight accessory to carry and protect your glasses. Handmade with an elegant and bold Soft Italian Calf leather, its soft suede interior in a matching tone keeps your most valued glasses safe and secure while the nosepiece holder on the inside will help keep the structure when pressing against the popper.

name: Heritage St James Lid-Over Attaché Case
description: Our St James Lid-Over Attaché Case is a smaller and lighter version of the attaché used by our founder Gerry Ettinger back in the 1930s. The handmade attaché case is the perfect size to fit documents, notebooks, a laptop and other work essentials. The briefcase comes with a complimentary matching Ettinger Card Case and an Ettinger Leather Balm to ensure the best care.

name: Capra Ecru Medium Jewellery / Cufflink Box
description: Keep all your jewellery and cufflinks neatly organised with our Capra Ecru Medium Stud Box. Featuring four compartments separated by removable dividers and a soft suede pillow, the box will protect all your favourite pieces and is perfect for home or travel, whether resting on your dressing table or accompanying you around the world.

name: Capra Ecru Small Jewellery / Cufflink Box
description: Beautifully organise all your jewellery and cufflinks in this Capra Ecru Small Stud or Jewellery Box. Handmade from durable goat leather, and lined with soft contrasting suede interior, this elegant box is designed to keep your treasured pieces safe whether at home or while travelling. A luxurious accessory in its own right, it will add a refined touch to any dressing table.

name: Pursuits Piccadilly Canvas Tote
description: Enhance your style with this elegant Piccadilly Canvas Tote. This versatile bag is an essential companion whether it is for your everyday commute or a day trip to the city. Inside, you'll find a zipped pocket that divides the tote into two spacious compartments, ensuring excellent organisation. For added convenience, the tote comes with a removable leather shoulder strap.

name: Sterling Coat Wallet with 20 C/C
description: When kept in a jacket or coat pocket, coat wallets are much more discreet than billfolds due to their long and slim design. Our Sterling Coat Wallets with 20 C/C fit plenty of cards and notes, without making the wallet heavy. This beautiful crisp black wallet surprises you with the rich vibrant colour on the interior for those who like to stand out. The wallet looks elegant when in hand and keeps your cards and notes perfectly organised.

name: 35mm Waxy Leather Belt
description: Elevate all your daily looks with our classic 35mm Waxy Leather belts. This luxury belt will soon become your new wardrobe essential, enhancing your casual attires. Meticulously handmade with the finest calf leather on the outside and natural nubuck on the inside, this belt will wear well and acquire a beautiful patina over time. Belt size is measured from the middle hole to the buckle , and is usually one size larger than your waist. Please find our full size guide here .

name: Sterling 6-Hook Key Case
description: The Sterling 6 Hook Key Case is an elegant and practical accessory to keep your keys organised. With its six key hooks, two slip pockets, one card pocket and a zipped compartment for coins, the case helps you carry all your essentials in one place. Handmade from soft Italian calf leather and available in four vibrant colours inspired by British bank notes, it combines function with an elegant finish.

name: Sterling Stirrup Keyring - Two Tone
description: Elevate your keys with this luxury Sterling Stirrup Keyring in Two Tones. Handmade with Soft Italian Calf leather, this keyring is available in four bright colours making it easy to find your keys in any bag. Please note, for personalisation, the keyrings can fit up to 2-3 initials, depending on the characters.

name: Sterling A5 Notebook Cover
description: Our Sterling Notebook Cover is an elegant accessory to store all your daily notes. Handmade with a Soft Italian Calf leather and available in four vibrant colours inspired by British bank notes, it features two slip pockets which hold any A5 notebooks as well as additional papers. Each notebook cover includes a removable lined Rhodia notebook and a leather bookmark in a matching colour.

name: Chelsea Leather Tote
description: Our sophisticated Chelsea Leather Tote was designed with practicality and style in mind. Handmade with fine cow hide, this tote will add timeless elegance to your everyday looks. Featuring a small internal zipped pocket, three pen slots and a card slot, the tote provides ample room for all your essentials.

name: Saint Crispin Visiting Card Case
description: The Saint Crispin Visiting Card Case is an elegant accessory that will keep your business cards organised. It also works as a great alternative to wallets and purses fitting folded notes and credit cards. Made from the finest vegetable tanned calf leather, the leather has an exceptionally silky touch which burnishes naturally over time.

name: Steel Flask Funnel
description: Fill up your flask without losing a drop with this Steel Flask Funnel. We recommend you to pour your liquid slowly, and to lift the funnel up just enough to create a small gap between the base of the funnel and the top of the flask nozzle to allow air to escape, preventing air bubble blocking the funnel.

name: Sterling 6oz Hip Flask
description: Our 6oz Hip Flask make the perfect travel companion to take with you on your next trip, while keeping you warm on a cold outdoorsy day. Available in four vibrant colours inspired by the British notes, the stainless steel flask is wrapped in Soft Italian Calf leather, keeping your fingers protected from the cold metal.

name: Sterling Luggage Tag
description: Our Sterling Luggage Tag, available in four vibrant colours inspired by British bank notes, is the perfect travel companion and a thoughtful gift. Handmade from Soft Italian Calf, it is designed to resist scratches, ideal for frequent travel. The secure flap keeps your contact details discreet, while the buckle ensures it stays firmly attached to your bag, or suitcase.

name: Capra Ecru Oblong Valet Tray
description: Our Oblong Valet Tray is one of our most versatile accessories, both for your travels and home. Use it on your desk or bedside table to keep your favourite jewellery or watches, adding a touch of elegance to your décor. When traveling, you can unfasten the monogrammed buttons to flat pack the tray.

name: Saint Crispin Flat Credit Card Case
description: Our Flat Credit Card Case is perfect for the minimalist who only carries a few cards. Saint Crispin is our finest calf leather that is vegetable tanned to preserve the natural beauty. This card holder has 4 card pockets, a central slip pocket and it is finished in a very subtle way to give it an exceptionally silky touch and allow it to burnish naturally.

name: Heritage Westminster Flap-Over Briefcase
description: Elevate your business attire with the classic Westminster Flap-Over Briefcase. Handmade using the finest Buttero leather on the outside and a complimentary neutral-toned suede on the inside, this timeless case is finished with brass fittings. The briefcase has a sturdy and strong frame and features two large compartments inside for your papers, notebooks, a small laptop or an iPad.

name: Sterling Passport Case
description: Keep your passport on hand and protected with our Sterling Passport Case. Available in four vibrant colours, inspired by British bank notes, this case is the perfect travel companion and makes it easy to spot your passport in any bag, avoiding stress at the airport or train station. The case also features two side pockets to keep the passport in place and carry a few notes and tickets.

name: Heritage Mayfair Briefcase
description: Elevate your professional style with our classic Mayfair Briefcase. With its contemporary twist, this briefcase fits all daily business essentials and keeps your papers, pens, travel cards and even an iPad, neatly organised. You can choose to carry it by its elegant handles, or effortlessly attach the shoulder strap to wear it across your shoulder, allowing you to move with confidence and style.

name: Walkie Pen Refills
description: Extend the life of your Walkie Pen with this set of six refills.

name: Walkie Pen
description: Elegant and miniature, our Walkie Pen is the perfect size to keep in your wallet, address book or notepad. The Walkie Pen is available in two colours, black and pink but is supplied with two blue ink refills (including the one already in the pen). Additional refills can be ordered directly through our website and showroom or in specialised stationery shops.

name: Sterling Pill Case
description: Store all your medication and supplements in style with our luxury Sterling Pill Case. Handmade with Soft Italian Calf leather, the case includes seven pill boxes, one for each day of the week. Each box features three removable dividers to create four compartments, allowing organisation into four daily dosing times. The top of the boxes slide off easily, making access to the pills simple and quick.

name: Saint Crispin Mini Wallet with 6 C/C
description: This handmade Mini Wallet is perfect for minimalists. The wallet offers various pockets for cards and notes and fits neatly inside jacket pockets. Saint Crispin is our finest calf leather that is vegetable tanned to preserve the natural beauty. It is finished in a very subtle way to give it an exceptionally silky touch and allow it to burnish naturally.

name: Sterling 8oz Hunter Flask with 4 Cups
description: Share your favourite drink using our Sterling 8oz Hunter Flask with 4 Cups. Available in four vibrant colours inspired by the British notes, the stainless steel flask is wrapped in Soft Italian Calf leather, keeping your fingers protected from the cold metal. The 4 cups are attached to the top of the flask with a removable leather strap, perfect for hiking, fishing trips, or sharing on the go.

name: Jotter Pad Refills
description: Keep your ideas flowing with a fresh Jotter Pad Refill. With 90 crisp pages, it’s perfect for capturing every thought and inspiration, replenish your supply today.

name: Capra Ecru Square Valet Tray
description: Keep all your trinkets effortlessly organised in our Capra Ecru Square Valet Tray. Whether is it used in the hallway to keep your change and keys, or on a bedside table to carry your jewellery and glasses, this elegant tray will decorate your space with its luxurious goat leather exterior and contrasting suede interior.

name: Pursuits Wimbledon Briefcase
description: Elevate your daily commute with our Wimbledon Briefcase. Crafted with sturdy cotton drill and trimmed waxy hide, this bag is the perfect mix of country and city style. Featuring several external and internal pockets, it fits all your work essentials such as laptop, notebooks, and more. It also comes with a detachable leather shoulder strap, allowing you to carry it with ease on your daily ventures.

name: 30mm Waxy Leather Belt
description: Refine every ensemble with our 30mm Waxy Leather Belts. This luxury belt will soon become your new wardrobe essential whether you wear it with your evening or day attire. Meticulously handmade with the finest calf leather on the outside and natural nubuck on the inside, this belt will wear well and acquire a beautiful patina over time. Belt size is measured from the middle hole to the buckle , and is usually one size larger than your waist. Please find our full size guide here .

name: Bridle Hide Travel Shoehorn
description: This sleek and compact leather Travel Shoehorn is the ultimate travel companion, making slipping into your shoes effortless, even when you’re on the go. From the Bridle Hide collection, the foldable metal shoehorn comes in a luxury leather pouch handmade from traditional English Bridle Hide Leather on the outside, and suede on the inside.

name: Bridle Hide Long Wallet with Zipped Pocket
description: Designed to fit comfortably and discreetly in a coat or jacket pocket, our Long Wallet with Zipped Pocket includes 6 credit card slots, 2 slip pockets and a zip for change. Ettinger has been making Bridle Hide Wallets since the 1930s and their timeless appeal, combined with our attentive craftsmanship, means this wallet will last for many years to come.

name: Croco Billfold with 3 C/C & Coin Purse
description: This compact leather wallet in our unique Croco print represents the best of British style. With a coin purse section and 3 credit card slots, it keeps all your notes, cards and change in one place. Note: Due to the Croco pattern we recommend adding maximum two initials on the item.

name: Sterling Billfold Wallet with 3 C/C & Purse
description: This elegant leather wallet from our Sterling collection represents the best of British style. With a coin purse section, it keeps all your notes and change in one place. The exterior uses a fine black calf leather while the interior uses a buttery soft Italian calf leather in bold tones, Inspired by the regal hues of British bank notes.

name: Sterling Money Clip Wallet
description: Designed to be as slim and simple as possible, this cash clip wallet will hold a wad of bank notes in the middle, four credit cards on the left and some smaller tickets and paper notes on the right-hand side. The exterior uses a fine black calf leather while the interior uses a buttery soft Italian calf leather in bold tones, Inspired by the regal hues of British bank notes

name: Croco Flat Credit Card Case
description: Small yet extremely stylish, our handmade Croco Card Holder will protect your cards and fits neatly in the smallest pockets. The embossed crocodile print on glazed cowhide gives this collection a very special look and feel. Note: Due to the Croco pattern we recommend adding maximum two initials on the item.

name: Sterling Flat Credit Card Case
description: Our Sterling Flat Credit Card Case is perfect for the everyday minimalist who only wants to carry a few cards and a couple of notes. Inspired by the regal hues of the Sterling British notes, the case exudes style and elegance with its rich colours. This card holder has 4 card pockets and a central slip pocket where you can keep receipts or a few neatly folded notes.

name: Sterling Midi Flap-Over Purse
description: The smooth black exterior with a rich pop of colour on the inside, makes this Midi Flap-Over the perfect everyday companion. It keeps all your important daily necessities organised and fits into smaller bags effortlessly. Inspired by the regal hues of British bank notes, our Sterling collection uses black calf leather on the exterior with a vibrant soft, drum rolled leather on the interior.

name: Sterling Zipped Curved Wallet With Key Strap
